description: This file implements the FileDescriptor class, which manages file descriptors including duplication, validation, resetting, and releasing file descriptors, with logging for error handling.

classes.name: FileDescriptor
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a file descriptor, providing safe management including duplication, validation, reset, release, and proper cleanup.

methods.name: FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the file descriptor to invalid (-1).

methods.name: FileDescriptor(int fd)
methods.description: Constructor that duplicates an existing file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: FileDescriptor(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy constructor that duplicates the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: operator=(FileDescriptor &&other) noexcept
methods.description: Move assignment operator that transfers ownership of the file descriptor.

methods.name: operator=(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy assignment operator that duplicates the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: ~FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Destructor that resets (closes) the file descriptor.

methods.name: isValid()
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is valid (non-negative).

methods.name: reset(int fd)
methods.description: Resets the file descriptor to a new value, closing the old one if necessary.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Clears the current file descriptor, closing it if valid.

methods.name: release()
methods.description: Releases ownership of the file descriptor and returns it, setting internal descriptor to invalid.
